verdict.rationale: NVIDIA publishes 141GB of HBM3e at 4.8 TB/s, enough capacity to hold a quantized 70B-class model on a single GPU with ample headroom. It also cites a specific Llama2 70B inference result (1.9X faster than H100). Community commenters corroborate that LLM inference is memory-bound and that the faster HBM3e is the key upgrade. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of a quantized 70B model actually running on a single H200 (throughput or latency figures beyond vendor claims).
